lastChange.note: Frames drawn at the same moment are wired together: crumbs, zoom, views and Needs you move between the screens drawn at that moment (17 frames, two moments), and a need or the ask field opens its window over the screen you are on. Every state reached is the static frame pixel for pixel (55 states per theme); the brand book lists what stays static and why. Map2Part's zoom could not be clicked (its grid covered the title row); Map3Reviewer and Learning now show the moment's two needs.
